meta.source: Coded from the published QP and mark scheme (1MA1/2H, Monday 3 June 2024, P76925A), downloaded from qualifications.pearson.com. Derived metadata only — question numbers, marks, mark-scheme codes and skill tags. No exam question text transcribed.
meta.note: Coded in the same sitting as EDEXCEL-JUN24-F-P2. The crossover block is 2F q20–q26 = 2H q1–q7, contiguous, and the marks match item for item (2, 3, 2, 4, 6, 4, 4). All 22 (Total for Question) lines recovered and summing to the printed 80. Coded WITH mark_split.

coding_notes: q1–q7 are 2F q20–q26 and carry identical skill tags, kinds and mark splits to that file, by design.

q14a tagged gradient_of_a_curve, not kinematic_graphs: the mark scheme scores zero without a drawn tangent, which is exactly what that node was added for. q14b stays on kinematic_graphs — an area under a velocity-time curve by strips.

q8 tagged area_and_volume_scale_factors before areas_of_triangles — the first process mark is converting a drawing area to a real area through the SQUARE of the scale, which is the whole point of the item.
q17 tagged area_and_volume_scale_factors alone: both ratios in the mark scheme are scale-factor conversions, one from masses (a volume ratio) and one from surface areas.
q19b tagged vectors rather than vector_proof — it is a one-mark follow-through reading of whether the part (a) expression is a multiple of b, not a proof.
q22 tagged circle_theorem_tangent then congruence_and_similarity: the first communication mark is the tangent-radius right angle and the last is the RHS congruence that follows.
q12a and q12b tagged inverse_proportion and proportion_with_powers together — the relationship is inverse AND to a power, and neither node alone states it.
